name: Montana 4-H Congress
what_you_do: Spend four days on the Montana State University campus. Go to hands-on workshops and join contests (optional). Meet new people and build leadership skills. Teens can also apply to be state ambassador officers.
who_can_apply: Montana 4-H youth who are at least 13 years old as of October 1 of the 4-H year. Chaperones must be certified 4-H volunteers or MSU Extension staff, age 21 or older.
pay_detail: $285. It covers lodging for 3 nights, 7 meals, program costs and a t-shirt. Campus parking costs extra.
deadline_text: The next Congress is July 14 to 17, 2027. Registration opens May 1. The state registration deadline is June 15. Ambassador officer applications are also due June 15.
how_to_apply: Register online in the 4-H Zsuite system. Each county has its own deadlines and steps, so call your county Extension office early.
notes: You do not have to enter a contest. Youth State Awards are due May 1.
